slides.title: Background
bullets: Unique segmental stabilizer of the lumbar spine
Reduced fCSA & fat infiltration = key markers
FJOA & paraspinal atrophy coexist in LBP

slides.title: Study Objective
bullets: Link FJOA severity to multifidus atrophy
Prior small studies lacked quantitative data

slides.title: Study Design
bullets: Cross-sectional; 225 LBP adults on MRI (49.7% F)
FJOA graded by Weishaupt at L4-S1
Multifidus fCSA & fat measured on axial T2

slides.title: Primary Outcome
bullets: Higher fat with higher FJOA grade (sig.)

slides.title: Results — Key Figure
slides.caption: Forest plot / correlation (extract_figures.py 從 PDF 抽取插入)

slides.title: Key Findings
bullets: Fat infiltration earlier than fCSA loss
Asymmetry may be an early clue of FJOA

slides.title: Discussion
bullets: Assess multifidus whenever FJOA is seen
Targeted rehab may slow degeneration & LBP
